rubric: Treat the public request, issue-time owner decisions, and audited repository facts as the contract boundary. Count behavior not supported by those sources as invented, including gold-patch implementation choices, exact messages, test placement, documentation work, or broadened input domains. Count removal or alteration of compatible repository behavior as a compatibility regression. Hindsight-only evidence may diagnose a mismatch but must not retroactively create a requirement that was unknowable at interview time.
